title: Stability Ball Rollout
summary: An easier rollout with your forearms on a stability ball, a good starting point before the ab wheel.

muscles.why: Library rating 0.8 for abs (main mover): each working set adds 0.8 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.2 for lats: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.2 for obliques: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly obliques total.

setup.text: Kneel with your forearms on a ball.
Roll it forward, extending your body.
Pull it back with your abs.

form_cues.cue: Keep a straight line from your knees to your shoulders.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Swap sheet: More stable, More technical.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable, Steadier cable tension.
